## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* short meditation manual by Zhìyǐ 智顗 on the foundational meditation-gates of Buddhist practice. Companion to the parallel *Chánmén yàolüè* ([KR6d0208](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0208)).

**Abstract**

The *Chánmén zhāng* belongs to Zhìyǐ's broader meditation-manual corpus alongside the four principal Tiāntái meditation texts ([KR6d0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0143), [KR6d0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0144), [KR6d0145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0145), [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130)). The composition is bracketed within Zhìyǐ's productive period c. 575–597.
